answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization, which focuses on automatically generating textual summaries from multiple customer reviews, has received increasing attention due to the rise of online review platforms.
answer_1.outputs: textual summaries from multiple customer reviews in a desired writing style

answer_2.quote: We use the F1 scores of ROUGE-1/2/L (Lin, 2004) and BERTScore for reference-based automatic evaluation. Additionally, we calculate the CTC score to evaluate the consistency and relevance of the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: We asked human annotators recruited from Appen to rate generated summaries on a 4-point Likert scale for each evaluation metric.
answer_4.guideline: We conducted human evaluations to compare the performance of our model (Napa ) with three baselines: Self-supervision, Pipeline, and Napa without Partial Supervision (PS) on PRO-SUM with respect to the fluency, relevance, and attractiveness of the generated summary.
